from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 X》')")
    cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal case cause identified in the document content")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
